summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing English translations of resolutions from its 122nd Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting and an Extraordinary Report. The meeting elected six Board members, including Akio Toyoda as Chairman and Kenta Kon as President. No transaction, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is solely a routine corporate governance update concerning board elections and shareholder meeting results. As a foreign private issuer reporting standard governance matters, the Form 6-K does not trigger any special-situation classification under the defined categories. There are no deal terms, premiums, or mechanics to analyze. This is a routine current report.
